grants.title: 2048Wars
grants.description:
Onchain competitive 2048 game where players compete for a shared prize pot. Traditional sliding puzzle mechanics - first to reach 2048 tile wins the current pot.

Key Features:
- BuilderScore threshold prevents bot/sybil attacks
- Weekly win cooldown per player ensures fair distribution
- Small entry fee (i.e. 0.001 ETH per game)
- Growing pot system: 5% creator fee, 5% seeds next week's pot, 90% to winner
- If no winner, pot rolls over to next week
- Created as a Farcaster mini app

Tech Stack: JavaScript frontend + Solidity smart contracts

Personal Goal: Practice and advance my JS/TS & Solidity skills building an onchain game

grants.title: YieldGuard: An AI-Driven Cross-Protocol Yield Optimization Agent
grants.description: YieldGuard is an AI-powered asset management solution for DeFi. Leveraging advanced machine learning and risk management, it analyzes yields across Ethereum protocols and Layer 2 networks, identifying optimal allocations while accounting for gas fees, impermanent loss, and market volatility. Key features include an adaptive AI engine that predicts yield trends and adjusts strategies in real time; risk-adjusted optimization that integrates metrics like gas costs and impermanent loss; seamless cross-protocol integration via MPC Wallet APIs; and a transparent, intuitive dashboard offering real-time insights and customizable parameters, empowering exact, real-time investment management tailored for diverse investors.

grants.title: Fiidbak
grants.description:
Fiidbak is an identity-verified feedback platform where creators upload products as ERC1155 tokens and users provide quality reviews. Both creators and reviewers must verify identity (self protocol) to prevent spam and ensure authenticity.
Users earn progressive NFT badges based on approved feedback: Seedling (1 review), Wood (5), Bronze (15), etc. Feedback automatically approves after reaching fixed number of vote, and only Wood+ badge holders can vote on feedback quality, with weighted voting power. Product owners have feedback approval rights too. 
The platform transforms anonymous feedback into verifiable, merit-based contributions while scaling quality control through progressive user empowerment rather than centralized moderation.

grants.title: EthIndexer
grants.description: EthIndexer revolutionizes blockchain data access by enabling users to index blockchain data simply by typing natural language commands, without writing complex queries. It instantly processes your input and auto-generates API endpoints that both frontend and backend applications can consume—making blockchain data integration effortless and fast.EthIndexer is an AI-driven platform that empowers developers, analysts, and businesses to index and structure blockchain data on demand. Users describe what they want indexed—whether it’s activity for specific addresses or particular data fields—and EthIndexer automatically creates tailored REST APIs to expose this data for seamless integration.

grants.title: Gasless Polls: A Practical EIP-712 Implementation for Community Voting
grants.description:
My project is a Gasless Poll dApp to eliminate voting gas fees. Users sign free, off-chain EIP-712 messages, it gets batched together for a single, efficient on-chain transaction.
This project's goal is twofold: to solve a real user experience problem and to create a clean, open-source Scaffold-ETH 2 learning template for the BuidlGuidl community, demystifying gasless design patterns. Blockchain provides the core trust layer via cryptographic proof, immutable settlement, and transparency.
My 2-week plan is to deliver a functional MVP: a Solidity contract, a Node.js relayer, and a React frontend, complete with a detailed README and demo video. Future plans include decentralizing the relayer with GSN and adding token-gated voting for DAOs

grants.title: Festivify: NFT Greetings for Every Celebration

grants.title: MerkleProofX is a platform the process of generating, managing Merkle proof
grants.description:
MerkleProofX is a no-code platform that simplifies the generation, management, and verification of Merkle proofs for Web3 projects. It allows developers, platforms, and communities to securely run airdrops, create whitelists, and set up token-gated access without writing custom smart contracts or backend scripts.

Through MerkleProofX, users can upload wallet addresses, automatically generate a Merkle tree and root, and retrieve proofs. Features include on-chain storage of Merkle roots, API integration for dynamic proof generation, and pre-built smart contracts for claim verification. Developers can either deploy our lightweight verifier contract or use our APIs to fetch and verify proofs directly in their frontend apps.

grants.title: Scaffold-NFT
grants.description:
Scaffold-NFT will be a fork of SE2 which seeks to make the development of NFT projects as easy and intuitive as SE2 does for general smart contracts. Of course, Scaffold-NFT will laser in NFT development by providing template NFT smart contracts for ERC721, ERC115, dn404, and other NFT-like styles. Additionally, the frontend development side of the project will contain useful components to, again easily and intuitively, interact with NFT smart contracts and display the data retrieved from them. Finally, someone should be able to use the website to upload to IPFS, by integrating the nft.storage api.

The combination of all of these factors will make it so that the developer can go through the entire processes of building, testing, and deploying, their NFT projects quickly and easily customize them to fit their project's requirements. Alongside, having a handy framework on the frontend for rendering NFT data and intuitive controls for the user.

Thank you very much for your consideration.
Jacob Homanics

grants.title: savvy
grants.description:
An interface for the EVM in the browser, to simulate and visualize your onchain activity, with special emphasis on the costs associated with it.

Think ~ Etherscan + Remix + Foundry.

Basically, it's a way to interact with a forked EVM chain, in a local-first environment, with a comprehensive set of actions/hacks/utilities exposed by Tevm—which is doing all the heavy lifting.

The state of each chain is the initial fork + all the local transactions, which are displayed in the history with all the details (data, errors, logs, inputs...).

And also, and that's one of the main points of savvy, details on the gas usage of each transaction (fee, L1 submission fee if relevant...).

You can think of it as a way of simulating a set of transactions, and visualizing the results, without having to actually send them to the network.

With no setup (wallet, signatures, etc.), in the browser, from any account (impersonation), with any amount of native tokens.

And much more to come; see https://docs.svvy.sh/progress

Winners of each batch are also rewarded with an nft which. The is also a in built point system which is expected to tract users usage so that can be rewarded with the protocol tokens when it goes life.
